certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Forces and Newton's Laws (Ages 14-17)

learning_outcomes.text: State Newton's three laws of motion and give an example of each
Use free-body diagrams to identify the forces acting on an object
Apply F = ma to calculate force, mass or acceleration
Explain inertia and why seatbelts and headrests matter
Identify action-reaction pairs and distinguish them from balanced forces
Apply safe, controlled methods when measuring motion

integrative_case: Hana designs a safe classroom investigation measuring a trolley's acceleration under different forces: she draws free-body diagrams, uses F = ma to predict results, links her findings to seatbelt design, and documents her safety controls.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
